#travel #sleep

Lisbon to Tokyo via Frankfurt (LH 1167 then LH 716) is 8 hours ahead, and the first time I did it I was a zombie for
five days. What works for me now: shift bedtime one hour earlier each of the 3 nights before flying, melatonin 0.5 mg
(not 5, the low dose is enough) at 22:00 destination time for max 4 nights, 20 minutes of outdoor morning light, and
no coffee after 13:00 local, see [[Caffeine cutoff]]. The day-2 crash at 15:00 still happens; a 25 minute nap with
an alarm is fine, 2 hours is a disaster. Flying west back home is way easier. Bigger picture stuff is in [[Sleep]].
